Any other type or duration of intrapartum antibiotics
cohort: 223,431 infants born 2007-2015 in an integrated healthcare system
finding: GBS-IAP was associated with a small but sustained increase in BMI starting at a very early age compared to no antibiotics in vaginal deliveries and other antibiotics in cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The study compared BMI outcomes for infants exposed to intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP) based on mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean), but did not examine specific associations between mode of delivery and BMI.
